title: 第 30章 陆云修为暴跌
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
回到内门之后的沈清璇走在前面脚步不快不慢，而苏婉清跟在她的身后一直想开口又不敢开口。

    走进院落之后沈清璇在椅子上坐了下来，她端起茶杯喝了一口然后看了苏婉清一眼。

    “有什么话就说吧别憋着了。”沈清璇淡淡道。

    只见苏婉清咬了咬牙然后走到沈清璇面前，她的脸上带着几分不甘心。

    “师父弟子有一事不明。”苏婉清说道。

    “说吧。”

    “您为什么要收那个陈默为徒。”苏婉清说道。

    “那个人就是个变态他根本不配做师父的弟子。”

    而沈清璇看着苏婉清脸上没有什么表情，她放下茶杯然后靠在椅背上。

    “变态，他怎么变态了。”沈清璇问道。

    然而苏婉清张了张嘴刚想说可话到嘴边又咽了回去，她在心里想着总不能告诉师父陈默闯进过她的房间还躲在浴池里偷看她洗澡吧。

    这种事说出来太丢人了，苏婉清的脸微微红了一下。

    “反正他就是个变态。”苏婉清说道。

    “弟子见过他几次每次都没有什么好事，而且他才金丹期的修为凭什么能入师父的眼。”

    “金丹期怎么了。”沈清璇说道。

    “为师当年也是从金丹期过来的，谁不是一步一步修炼上去的。”

    “可他不一样。”苏婉清说道。

    “他一个外门弟子身上有上品法器还有上品法术，这些东西是从哪来的。”

    “谁知道是不是偷来的，万一他品行不端以后给师父惹出麻烦怎么办。”

    当沈清璇听到这话之后沉默了片刻，她在心里想着苏婉清说的倒也不是没有道理。

    不过那个陈默身上的五雷道法确实不简单，圆满级别的上品雷法在内门都没有几个弟子能掌握。

    一个外门弟子能把雷法练到这种程度，要么是天赋极高要么是有天大的机缘。

    不管是哪一种都值得她亲自收徒，沈清璇在心里想着。

    “他身上的东西是从哪来的不重要。”沈清璇说道。

    “重要的是他确实有这个实力，外门弟子当中他的天赋是最好的。”

    “可师父……”

    “好了。”沈清璇打断了苏婉清的话。

    “为师已经做了决定这件事你不必再说了。”

    可是苏婉清咬了咬牙心中还是不甘，可师父已经这么说了她也不好再反对。

    这会儿她在心里想着那个陈默到底有什么好的，师父怎么就偏偏看中他了。

    “弟子还有一件事想问。”苏婉清说道。

    “说。”

    “那个陈默施展的五雷道法，那是上品法术吧。”苏婉清说道。

    “弟子很好奇他一个外门弟子是从哪弄来这么多高深的上品法术的。”

    “就算是内门弟子能有一门上品法术就不错了，他手上好像有好几门的样子。”
content_en:
After returning to the inner door, Shen Qingxuan walked in front neither fast nor slow, while Su Wanqing followed behind her, always wanting to speak but not daring to.

    After entering the courtyard, Shen Qingxuan sat down on the chair. She picked up the tea cup and took a sip before looking at Su Wanqing.

    "If you have anything to say, just say it and don't hold it back." Shen Qingxuan said calmly.

    Su Wanqing gritted her teeth and walked up to Shen Qingxuan, with a bit of unwillingness on her face.

    "Master, disciple, there is something unclear." Su Wanqing said.

    "Say it."

    "Why did you accept that Chen Mo as your disciple?" Su Wanqing said.

    "That man is a pervert. He is not worthy of being Master's disciple."

    Shen Qingxuan saw that Su Wanqing had no expression on her face. She put down her teacup and leaned back in her chair.

    "Pervert, why has he become a pervert?" Shen Qingxuan asked.

    However, Su Wanqing opened her mouth and was about to say something, but she swallowed it back. She thought in her heart that she couldn't tell her master that Chen Mo had broken into her room and hid in the bathtub to watch her bathing.

    It was so embarrassing to say such a thing, Su Wanqing's face turned slightly red.

    "He's just a pervert anyway." Su Wanqing said.

    "Disciple has seen him several times and nothing good has happened every time. Besides, how can his cultivation at the golden elixir stage be in Master's eyes?"

    "What happened to the Golden Core Stage?" Shen Qingxuan said.

    "When I was a teacher, I also came from the Golden Core stage. Who didn't practice step by step?"

    "But he is different." Su Wanqing said.

    "One of his outer disciples has a high-grade magical weapon and a high-grade spell. Where did these things come from?"

    "Who knows if it was stolen? What if he misbehaves and causes trouble for Master in the future?"

    When Shen Qingxuan heard this, she was silent for a moment, thinking that what Su Wanqing said was not unreasonable.

    However, Chen Mo's Five Thunder Techniques are indeed not simple. Only a few disciples in the inner sect can master the perfect level of high-grade thunder techniques.

    For an outer sect disciple to be able to practice lightning to such an extent, he must either have extremely high talent or have a great opportunity.

    No matter which one it is, it is worthy of her to accept a disciple personally, Shen Qingxuan thought in her heart.

    "It doesn't matter where the things on his body come from," Shen Qingxuan said.

    "The important thing is that he does have this strength. His talent is the best among the outer disciples."

    "But Master..."

    "Okay." Shen Qingxuan interrupted Su Wanqing.

    "You don't need to say anything anymore as my master has already made a decision."

    But Su Wanqing gritted her teeth and still felt unwilling to give in, but the master had already said so and she could no longer object.

    At this moment, she was thinking about what was so good about Chen Mo and why the master chose him.

    "Disciple, there is one more thing I want to ask." Su Wanqing said.

    "Say."

    "The Five Thunder Dao Technique that Chen Mo performed must be a top-grade magic technique." Su Wanqing said.

    "This disciple is very curious about where an outer disciple of his got so many advanced and high-grade spells."

    "It would be great if an inner disciple could have a top-grade spell. He seems to have several at his disposal."
title_en: Chapter 30 Lu Yun’s cultivation level plummeted
